job.title: Investment Operations Analyst - Funds Management
job.description:
An established and growing fund manager is looking for an Investment Operations Analyst to join their team in Sydney.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone with experience across investment operations, trade processing, settlements, reconciliations and portfolio administration, looking to take ownership of the day-to-day operational requirements.

The Role
  • Manage day-to-day investment operations across multiple investment portfolios
  • Process and oversee investment trades, settlements and cash movements
  • Perform daily reconciliations across portfolios, cash, holdings and transactions
  • Investigate and resolve operational breaks and discrepancies
  • Coordinate settlement activities with brokers, custodians, fund administrators and other counterparties
  • Process corporate actions, distributions and other investment-related events
  • Maintain accurate portfolio, transaction and investment data
  • Support portfolio rebalancing and ensure transactions are processed accurately
  • Assist with operational reporting and investment data analysis
  • Work closely with investment, finance, compliance and other internal teams
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, controls and efficiencies
  • Support operational projects, system enhancements and process improvements
  • Ensure all activities are completed accurately and in line with relevant policies and controls
About You You will ideally have 2–5 years' experience in investment operations, fund operations, middle office or investment administration.
You will bring:
  • Strong understanding of the investment trade lifecycle
  • Experience with settlements, reconciliations and corporate actions
  • Exposure to investment portfolios and financial markets
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to investigate discrepancies
  • Good Excel and data analysis skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A proactive and hands-on approach to problem solving
  • Experience working with brokers, custodians, fund administrators or investment managers
This is a great opportunity to join a high-performing investment team where you will have genuine exposure to the full investment operations lifecycle and play an important role in supporting the broader investment function.

job.title: Company Secretary / Governance Manager
job.description:
An outstanding opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Company Secretary / Governance Manager to join a leading ASX-listed organisation within its Corporate Affairs, Risk & Legal team.

Supporting the Board, Board Committees and Executive Leadership Team, you will play a key role in delivering best-practice corporate governance while ensuring compliance with the Corporations Act, ASX Listing Rules and broader regulatory obligations.
This position will see you coordinate Board and Committee meetings, manage Board papers and minutes, provide governance advice to senior stakeholders, and maintain governance frameworks, policies and delegations. A significant aspect of the role involves overseeing governance across a portfolio of Australian and international subsidiary entities, working with external advisers and corporate service providers to ensure ongoing statutory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

To be successful, you will have significant experience in company secretariat or corporate governance within a large listed or multinational organisation, with proven expertise supporting Boards and managing complex governance requirements. Exposure to international subsidiary governance, strong stakeholder management skills and exceptional written communication are essential. A Governance Institute of Australia qualification or legal background will be highly regarded.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing governance team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, offering a competitive contract rate.
